searchLog: Read profile.md, target-companies.json (29 companies), sent-log.json (last ~40 opportunity titles), applications.json (empty), and life/PIPELINE.md for in-flight/closed exclusions (IBM x6, Claude Corps, Ford FCG, Red Ventures, TikTok, Goldman Sachs, CIL, MIT Future Fest, MLH, Horizon, 3x Adobe, Micron, Kalshi, MATS, Anthropic Fellows July, Northslope, Last Mile, Yale SOM). Also checked life/PROFILE.md: the Aug-vs-Dec-2026 graduation conflict this run was told to watch for is already resolved there (December 2026, settled 2026-08-04, matches morning-briefing/profile.md) -- no live conflict to reconcile. WebSearch worked and surfaced one strong-looking lead (Databricks 'Associate Product Manager, New Grad (2027 Start)', direct hit on target role #4, graduation Fall 2026/Spring 2027 stated as eligible per aggregator snippets). WebFetch was completely non-functional this run: every attempt returned EGRESS_BLOCKED, tested against www.anthropic.com and www.databricks.com (the actual Databricks careers URL for the APM req) as well as boards-api.greenhouse.io and api.ashbyhq.com in the prior three runs -- a total environment-level egress block on all outbound fetches, not a per-site policy (proxy status endpoint shows recentRelayFailures empty, meaning the block happens before the destination is even attempted). This is the same failure mode reported on 2026-09-08, 2026-09-09, and 2026-09-10 -- now four consecutive days. hunt.md requires confirming from the actual page that applications are open and the user is eligible; a search snippet or aggregator listing is explicitly disallowed as sole evidence. With no working fetch, no candidate -- including the promising Databricks APM lead -- could be verified, so nothing is included. Zero verified opportunities is the honest output; the underlying blocker is environmental (WebFetch egress), not a lack of findable opportunities, and has now persisted four days running.
